Elapsd

A simple time-since tracker for real life. Just “how long has it been since I.... ?”

Features

One-tap tracking

Log an event quickly without turning your life into a spreadsheet.

At-a-glance time since

See elapsed time clearly so you can make decisions without mental math.

Quiet by design

No urgency vibes. Just clean info that helps you stay consistent.

FAQ

Is it free?

Yep. It's just something I knocked out for myself to use, not something worth charging for.

Does it collect my data?

The short version: no creepy stuff. See the full Privacy Policy for specifics.

Can I request features?

Sure. It's a side project so no promises, but I do read messages.

Where do I get help?

Start with the Contact page. If it’s a real bug, I’ll want to fix it anyway.
